raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The DE-398 refactor on 2026-01-16 changed silver_transactions.txn_date to CAST(ingest_ts AS DATE). Batches land at 02:00 the day after the transaction, so txn_date is always one day after the date of txn_ts. That accounts for all 4600 POSTED rows, and the gold aggregates are keyed on the wrong date.
